requirements_summary: Workloads: low-latency chat (streaming), embeddings for KB search, periodic batch reranking for triage.
Latency/throughput targets: aim for median token latency < 300ms for chat; handle burst windows up to ~120 requests/min per team; org-level concurrency ~200.
Rate limiting: need per-api-key quotas, per-route concurrency caps, and global org throttles with graceful 429s + Retry-After header.
Burst handling: automatic short-term burst allowances for marketing events, plus clear overflow policy (fallback to smaller model variant or queued responses).
Concurrency limits: prefer guidance — recommended 6-8 concurrent streaming sessions per API key for current model choice; want tooling to observe queue length and throttles.
429 behavior: must surface 429s with structured reason codes, Retry-After TTL, and metrics hooks for alerts/webhooks.
Cost sensitivity: wants recommendations (quantization, lower-cost model for background processing, prefix caching) and visibility on token-by-route spend.
Security/compliance: SSO for admin, retention policy configurable for logs, audit trail of rate-limit changes; no air-gapped requirement today.
